instruction: Set VLC's recording directory to the Desktop folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VLC Media menu, navigated to Open Network Stream, entered HLS URL, and started playback in 11 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC menus, open dialogs, type URLs, interact with VLC UI controls.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests VLC preferences navigation instead of streaming. Agent proved it can navigate VLC menus; now test changing a setting in Tools > Preferences.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC Tools > Preferences > Input/Codecs and changing the recording directory. Evaluator kills VLC to force config save, then reads vlcrc to check input-record-path setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC config file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) from the VM, which contains the recording directory setting.
Metric (is_vlc_recordings_folder) correctly parses the vlcrc file, searches for the 'input-record-path' key, and compares its value to the expected path.
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is semantically correct for the Linux Desktop folder.
Postconfig properly kills VLC before reading config, ensuring the config file is saved to disk with any changes the agent made.
Metric correctly handles the 'rule' type expected parameter — accesses rule['recording_file_path'] directly from the rules dict passed by get_rule.
Single-step instruction (set recording directory) is fully covered by the single evaluator check.
